decisions.statement: A clip named without its transcript is refused.
A clip named is carried to the host before the request is made.
A call naming no clip uses the clip the host was provisioned with.
An answer that is no RIFF payload is a fault rather than a file written.
The audio is written where the caller named that audio and nowhere else.
Nothing here cuts the text into pieces.

definition: the command speaking text in the voice a reference clip carries
